seams.title: Add a static 'roll one more die and ignore the lowest' replacement and carry roll modifiers on the roll
seams.clause: "If you would roll one or more dice, instead roll that many dice plus one and ignore the lowest roll." (Pixie Guide, Barbarian Class). "Roll a d20 and subtract the number of cards in your hand." / "Roll a d20 and add the toughness of the creature you sacrificed this way." / "...add the number of creature cards in your graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn." / "...add the total mana value of those cards." read together with "If any of those results was 10 or higher, draw a card." (Farideh), "Whenever you roll a die's highest natural result" (Netherese Puzzle-Ward) and "When you roll a natural 20" (Critical Hit).
seams.why: (a) The only dice replacement is the one-shot ScopedEffect ModRollExtraDieIgnoreOne in game/dice_roll.go, whose extra die is ignored by a chooser. A permanent's static replacement on RepEventRollDice that adds a die and raises DiceRoll.IgnoreLowest is missing (two of them stack: two more dice, two lowest ignored; CR 706.6 lets the roller pick among tied lowest). Expect: a card-side ReplacementEffect on RepEventRollDice in dice_roll.go/replacements.go plus a helper in effects/random_effects.go, with a Label. (b) EventRollDie.Amount is the face shown and nothing carries the modifier, so a trigger cannot tell the natural result from the result (CR 706.2). Expect: a Modifier on game.DiceRoll and on the EventRollDie event (additive snapshot field), RollDice{Modifier}, and WheneverYouRollDice handing the tail both. The four modifier cards then use it instead of adding inside their tails as diviners_portent.go does; the natural-result triggers must keep reading the unmodified face.
seams.checked: grep RepEventRollDice server/internal: only game/ (dice_roll.go, replacements.go, pending_choice.go, zone_route.go, scoped_replacements.go), no card. Normalized grep of effects/*.go for 'ignore the lowest roll', 'plus one and ignore', 'highest natural result', 'natural 20', 'subtract the number' = 0 files each. grep 'Natural|Modifier|Modified' game/events*.go game/effect_api_random.go = nothing. Read dice_roll.go header, random_effects.go, diviners_portent.go, CR 706.2 and 706.6 in cmdr/cr.txt.

seams.title: Roll dice as an activation cost and as a permanent enters
seams.clause: "{6}, Roll a d8: Monstrosity X, where X is the result." (Clay Golem). "As this creature enters, roll X d6. It enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the total of those results." (Neverwinter Hydra).
seams.why: Every roll goes through RollDiceThenForEffect from a resolving effect, with the rest as a registered tail. A roll that is part of paying a cost (its result fixed before the ability is on the stack, visible to 'whenever you roll', replaceable by s1's static and able to pause for Squid Fire Knight's question mid-payment) has no cost kind; and no enters-with replacement rolls dice while the permanent is entering (the entry would have to wait on the dice window). Expect: a RollDieCost in effects/activated.go with the result stored on PaidCost (game/paid_cost.go) for the effect to read, and an as-enters hook that rolls before counters are placed (game/dice_roll.go + the enters-with path). Build after s1: both edit dice_roll.go.
seams.checked: Listed every exported *Cost constructor in effects (grep '^func [A-Z][A-Za-z]*Cost('): no roll cost. Normalized grep of the game package for 'roll a d[0-9]+ as a cost|RollAsCost|CostRoll' = 0; effects for 'Roll X d6' = 0; no effects file contains both RollDice/RollDie and EntersWith/AsEnters. Monstrosity itself exists (effects/monstrosity.go, hydra_broodmaster.go 'Monstrosity X').

seams.title: Give a token only the triggered abilities of the cards exiled to pay for it (Vecna)
seams.clause: "{T}, Exile The Book of Vile Darkness and artifacts you control named Eye of Vecna and Hand of Vecna: Create Vecna, a legendary 8/8 black Zombie God creature token with indestructible and all triggered abilities of the exiled cards."
seams.why: ADR 0155's borrow (game/borrowed_triggers.go, effects/borrowed_triggers.go HasActivatedAndTriggeredAbilitiesOf) lends activated abilities and, with AbilityBorrow.Triggered, triggered ones as well; there is no triggered-only borrow, and giving Vecna the Book's and the Hand's activated abilities would be stronger than printed. The lenders here are the cards exiled as this activation's cost (one, two or three cards, as they last existed), fixed for a token rather than a permanent's own static; LastChosenExiledCardLender covers one chosen card only. Also needed: a cost that exiles the source plus every artifact you control with either name. Expect: a TriggeredOnly flag on game.AbilityBorrow, a lender reading the cost's exiled cards, and the token row. Eye of Vecna and Hand of Vecna are built here so the three are tested together (Hand's 'equipped creature or a creature you control named Vecna'; 'Equip—Pay 1 life for each card in your hand' should reuse game/life_cost_count.go).
seams.checked: Normalized grep of effects for 'all triggered abilities of the exiled' and 'has all triggered abilities' = 0; 'AllTriggeredAbilitiesOf|triggered abilities of' = 9 files, all the activated-and-triggered borrow (borrowed_triggers.go, Koh) or trigger doublers. Read effects/borrowed_triggers.go.

batches.theme: Complex legends
batches.shared: Rules-heavy. Orcus: ETB reading the X it was cast with (0 when not cast); mode 2 'Return up to X target creature cards with total mana value X or less' is the total rule of game/target_set.go (#4616; the_rise_of_sozin.go, marshals_anthem.go); mode 1 reads as a board wipe: declare its Sweep. Gelatinous Cube: bronzebeak_foragers.go has both halves ('exile ... until this creature leaves' and '{X}...: Put target ... card with mana value X exiled with this creature into its owner's graveyard'). Lorcan: 'put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere' (dauthi_voidwalker.go, bloodchief_ascension.go), pay life equal to mana value, enters as a Warlock in addition; 'If a Warlock you control would die, exile it instead' (29 precedents). Karazikar: 'Whenever you attack a player' once per attacked player with goad; 'an opponent attacks another one of your opponents'. Wulfgar: melee (game/melee.go) and the attack-trigger doubler (ancient_greenwarden.go-style helper in cmdr2_b08_helpers.go; 23 files). Nihiloor: 'for each opponent, tap up to one untapped creature you control. When you do, gain control ...' as hapatra_the_desert_frost.go / omega_heartless_evolution.go for the per-opponent shape, garland_royal_kidnapper.go for control 'for as long as you control'. Krydle: a combat-damage trigger with four instructions in order, and 'Whenever you attack, you may pay {2}'. Froghemoth: 'up to that many target cards from their graveyard', the number of targets coming from the damage event. Orcus, Lorcan, Nihiloor and Froghemoth are the watch items: stop and report if the per-opponent reflexive trigger, the total-mana-value target rule or a target count read from the triggering event does not fit.
